content: This function shall also allow to set “0” as the time frame for triggering which will result in a n (almost) immediate stop of the watchdog triggering and an (almost) instantaneous watchdog reset of the ECU. In case the counter value stored inside watchdog has the value "0", the service Wdg_SetTriggerCondition shall do nothing, which means it shall ign ore the counter passed by the parameter to Wdg_SetTriggerCondition.
